Description:
[b][color=#e06666][size=5][center]!PLEASE READ THIS![/center][/size][/color][/b]
This is not the main mod!!! These are only retextures of portraits WhisperWillow's mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20362]Baulder's Valley - BG3 Replacement Mod[/url].

[center][size=3][b][u]Instructions[/u][/b][/size]

1. You should download:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20362]Baulder's Valley - BG3 Replacement Mod[/url] 
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture
[/url]
2. Make sure you don't have any of Portraiture mods installed for Elliot.

3. After this, press [b][i]P[/i][/b] button during a dialogue with Astarion.[/center]

I drew Asta[size=2]rion's face to match [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5269][size=2]tal[/size]kohlooeys' Portraits[/url] style. Many thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/47621113?tab=user+files]EvellynYuri[/url]﻿ for the code for replacing portraits! <3
